quarterly_data.signal: Company view in the report: the global bonding-wire market is led by four makers (MK Electron plus German and Japanese companies); MK says it reached the No.1 global bonding-wire market share in 2022 (company claim) and that demand for high-performance materials is rising with packaging advances, HBM and automotive growth and more back-end outsourcing, so it is upgrading high-speed production and precision quality control and securing next-generation product capacity for HBM and automotive packages. It makes PC/APC wire under a licence and royalty agreement with Nippon Micrometal Corporation, and receives a 3.5% royalty on the Gold Bonding Wire processing fee from its Kunshan subsidiary. New businesses: water-soluble solder paste for semiconductor packages with in-house flux, Pd-alloy test material for pogo-pin heads (aimed at replacing Japanese-sourced material), and silicon anode materials for batteries (semi-mass-production line since 2015). In June 2026 the board approved selling 100% of environmental-services subsidiary Dongbu Entec, now reported as a discontinued operation.
quarterly_data.figure: No.1 global bonding-wire share in 2022 (company claim); 3.5% royalty from Kunshan subsidiary
